images.title: A different order every day
images.purpose: Show that the sweet shop's orders change every day while the shop works the bill out the same way.
images.composition: Two order cards sit side by side in the middle of the frame with a plain laddu plate above and between them; generous white space around.
exact_structure: Two identical white order cards side by side, each with a thin #2B2B2B outline; the left card has a teal #0072B2 header strip and the right card an amber #E69F00 header strip.

Left card shows one flat coconut icon (a round grey #6B7280 circle with two small dots) beside the text "10 coconuts", and below it one flat jaggery block icon (a small amber #E69F00 rectangle) beside the text "5 kg jaggery".
Right card shows the same two icons in the same positions with the texts "8 coconuts" and "9 kg jaggery".
Above the gap between the cards, one plain round laddu plate (a grey #6B7280 outlined circle) holding exactly 3 round amber #E69F00 laddus.
Below the cards, centred, the text "Cost = ?" with the question mark in reddish purple #CC79A7.
No people, no faces, no money, no totals; the top third and the bottom edge are empty white space.
rejection: any number other than 10, 5, 8 and 9 on the cards
any cost or rupee amount printed
more than 3 laddus on the plate
images.takeaway: The order changes every day, so we want one short way to find the cost of any order.
images.description: Two order cards, 10 coconuts with 5 kg jaggery and 8 coconuts with 9 kg jaggery, beside a laddu plate and the question Cost = ?.
images.context: Shown beside the chapter opening text and the hook video, before any working.
images.teaching_notes: Ask what is different between the cards and what the shop does the same way each day.

image_decisions.why: The hook is the sweet shop's two different orders, and a picture of both makes the changing numbers visible.
